name: Texas sales tax on construction contracts
standard: Texas Tax Code Chapter 151; 34 Texas Administrative Code §§ 3.291 and 3.357
edition: Comptroller rules as in force at pack release
description: Enables the checks that keep a Texas estimate honest about who owes sales tax on materials. The contract form decides it: under a lump sum contract the contractor is the consumer of the materials and no tax is charged to the customer, while under a separated contract the contractor sells the materials and collects tax on that charge but not on new-construction labor. Repair, remodeling and restoration of nonresidential real property reverses the rule and taxes the total charge including labor, whereas the same work on residential property leaves labor untaxed. The rules check that a project declares its contract form and its work character, that the tax treatment applied matches the pair, and that the combined rate priced does not exceed the 8.25 percent ceiling. No rate table ships with this pack; the rules run against the rate the user sets for the jobsite.
rates_referenced: State 6.25 percent, local up to 2 percent, combined ceiling 8.25 percent
